My Story

Real life.
Real wellness.

I'm Briana — a mom of six, a wife, a teacher, a trainer, and someone who knows firsthand what it feels like to be last on your own list.

I've spent ten years in the fitness industry — working in gyms, training clients one on one, and building a presence in the wellness community. And through all of it, I kept coming back to one truth: sustainable wellness isn't about doing more. It's about coming back to the well. Returning to what gives you life.

The WELLness Collective was born from that truth. It's for the woman who is busy, stretched thin, and still showing up every day — and who wants to be the best version of herself. You deserve a program that meets you exactly where you are.

You don't need perfection. You need a plan, a coach, and a community that gets it.

I'll meet you at the Well. — Briana

✦

A WELLness Collective Program

The Foundation

For Young Female Athletes · Ages 9–14

The Foundation is about giving young girls exactly that — a foundation. A place to build strength, discover confidence, and develop the habits, beliefs, and self-knowledge that will carry them through life.

Multiple sessions offered each week — choose what fits best into your schedule!

Strength

Build real, functional strength and conditioning designed to prevent injury and develop athletic confidence.

Mobility

Develop balance, flexibility, and body awareness — the foundation of every great athlete.

Mindset

Learn healthy self-talk, set meaningful goals, and build the mental habits that create lifelong confidence.

Community

Train alongside other young women who are showing up for themselves. There is power in that room.
